reviews.title: Randomly changed configurations on me and wiped out all of my videos and scripts.
reviews.text:
So I was in the middle of editing a video, and suddenly a random window opens up, allowing me to post my videos with the click of one button. I bypass that option, and suddenly the app layout looks completely  different and every single one of my recordings are deleted. 

Every single one of them. 

My scripts are also gone. 

Every SINGLE one of them. 

If this isn’t a nasty glitch than this app is borderline worthless. If it’s a glitch, then this app is completely unreliable.

Oh, and your viewers will absolutely know that you’re looking at a script. The only way to make it look like you’re looking at your camera lens is if you’re looking at the very top of your screen just below the lenses. 

This app definitely does not live up to the hype from their ads.

Update: the makers tried to communicate with me, but it seemed like they weren’t actually reading my messages and it turned into a back-and-forth. I ended up deleting the app.

reviews.title: Extremely disappointing customer service
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with BIGVU. I had an issue involving my purchase/subscription through the Apple App Store and reached out to BIGVU by email for help. Despite taking the time to explain the situation and contact them directly, I have received no response.

It’s incredibly frustrating to pay for a service and then be completely ignored when there’s a problem. I understand that Apple handles certain App Store transactions, but that doesn’t excuse a company from responding to a customer who is genuinely trying to get an issue resolved.

The lack of communication alone has completely changed my opinion of BIGVU. Customer service matters, especially when someone is paying for your product. I expected at least a response or some kind of guidance, and instead I’ve been left with nothing.

I would strongly recommend thinking twice before paying for this service if you expect responsive customer support when something goes wrong.

reviews.title: Live
reviews.text:
I really wanted to love BIGVU because the teleprompter is great when it works. Unfortunately, the live streaming feature has been a huge disappointment.

I’ve spent over two hours troubleshooting. I’ve updated the app, restarted my phone, disconnected and reconnected Facebook, logged out and back in, checked permissions, followed every step from BIGVU support, and even worked through additional troubleshooting with ChatGPT. Nothing has resolved the issue.

Every time I try to go live, I get “Error initiating live session.” At this point, the live feature simply doesn’t work, making it impossible for me to use one of the main reasons I subscribed.

I hope the developers fix this soon because the app has potential, but right now I can’t recommend it if reliable live streaming is important to you.

I wish someone had given me that warning before I spent hundreds of dollars and countless hours building my workflow around BIGVU.

I lost access to a large batch of content that was filmed directly inside the app. My projects would not load, the app crashed when attempting to access projects, create new projects, or record new content, and I spent over two hours with support trying to find a solution.

Despite repeatedly explaining the severity of the issue, no solution was provided, no recovery path was offered, and there appeared to be little urgency despite the fact that creators can lose hours, days, or even weeks of work when these issues occur.

This is the second time I have reported serious app issues. When I pointed out that there appears to be an ongoing problem with the platform, I was simply told it would be “looked into.” That same response was given the first time, yet here I am again facing the exact same issue.

What shocked me most was the lack of support. After spending over two hours trying to get help, I still had no answers, no fix, and no confidence that anyone actually understood the impact of losing access to creator content. When I asked about canceling my subscription, I couldn’t even get assistance with that.

reviews.title: CRASHES
reviews.text: I paid for the full subscription and waited for several updates to see if the crashes would stop, but the crashes are so bad that you cannot record a video with the tele prompt, the whole purpose of having the premium subscription. I honestly thought it was a scam because how can they charge a lot of money to adapt that does not work. I thought it was just me, but then I started looking at the comments and almost a lot of people have the same issue. Please fix this because it’s a great app with a lot of good features, but you cannot use it if it crashes every 30 seconds.
